blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Monday rejected calls for the agency to stop processing visa applications. This comes after Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla, in a radio interview, accused the DFA of turning visa issuance into a business, adding that it shouldn’t be the DFA’s responsibility to process visas. “The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) strongly objects to the recent public remarks of Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla calling for the removal of the Department’s visa-issuance functions and alleging that the DFA has turned Philippine visa issuance into a business,” the DFA wrote in a statement.
